name: sonic hedgehog signaling molecule
pathways: negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: SHH encodes sonic hedgehog protein [Cleaved into: Sonic hedgehog protein N-product]. Annotated molecular activities include endopeptidase activity and morphogen activity. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to holoprosencephaly 3 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Medulloblastoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports sequence alteration context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
